instruction: Please turn off Chrome Sync to prevent my browsing data from being synchronized across devices.

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling Chrome Sync. Custom getter get_chrome_sync_disabled__97c301f6 checks Chrome Preferences for sync.requested, signin.allowed, and sync_disabled settings. Returns 'true' when sync is disabled.
metadata.verification: Custom getter verifies Chrome Sync is disabled by checking multiple sync-related flags in Preferences.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads Chrome Preferences file from appropriate OS-specific locations
Metric (exact_match with expected='true') appropriately verifies sync is disabled
Postconfig correctly restarts Chrome to ensure preferences are persisted to disk
Evaluator covers the main requirement: verifying Chrome Sync is turned off
Logic at chrome.py:51 has confusing boolean logic combining sync.requested and signin.allowed that may not cover all edge cases
Getter returns 'false' on exceptions (chrome.py:59) rather than failing evaluation, which could hide configuration/permission issues and cause false negatives
Despite logic complexity, the final return statement checks 'not signin.allowed' separately which should catch most sync-disabled states
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Simplify getter logic at chrome.py:51-56 to make sync detection clearer and more robust
Consider raising an exception or returning an error indicator instead of 'false' when file read fails, to distinguish between 'sync enabled' and 'cannot verify'
Add logging to indicate which specific flag(s) determined the sync status for debugging purposes
